messages:
alex_support: Hey team — Acme reported intermittent 401s starting right after our scheduled key rotation window (~1977777600). Only their SSO-linked API traffic is failing; other API keys for same customer are fine. Example from proxy logs:

```
[1977777701] request_id=1234abcd status=401 msg="signature_verification_failed" user=acme-app->svc
headers: Authorization: Bearer <token-redacted>
```

Request ids: 1234abcd, 1234abce, 1234abcf. Seeing errors across eu-west-1 and a couple in us-west-2. Can oncall take a look? :rotating_light:

marta_sre: @alex_support ok grabbing logs. Do we have Vault revoke events around 1977777600? Also any canary rollout happening during the window? :eyes:

sam_reliability: I can repro locally by hitting the edge with the old vs new token. Quick reproduce steps:

```
# fetch token (simulated) from Vault
vault kv get -field=token secret/clients/acmepay | xargs -I{} curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer {}" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/pay
```

Old token -> 401 with same msg. New token from vault -> 200. Suggest check for env var caching in proxy sidecars (envproc) or long-lived process not reloaded.

kyle_platform: FYI the injector had a config that sets `SPRING_SECURITY_OAUTH_TOKEN_LIFETIME` in env and our sidecar reads it at start. If the rotation job rotated the secret but pods didn't restart (node taints during maintenance), they'd keep old token.

Try forcing a rollout of the proxy in the affected namespace:

```
kubectl -n acmepay rollout restart deployment/acmepay-proxy
kubectl get pods -n acmepay -o wide | grep CrashLoopBackOff || true
```

If pods can't restart due to imagepull or node problems, that's the reason they didn't pick up the rotated secret.

vault-bot: vault: revoke event recorded for `secret/clients/acmepay` at 1977777600 (rotator-service). action=revoke

marta_sre: Good — revoke event lines up. Sam, can you check if any ingress nodes still had pre-rotation sidecar? `kubectl exec` into the proxy and `env | grep ACME_TOKEN` should show.

sam_reliability: Did that. 2/60 pods still showed `ACME_TOKEN=redacted_old`. Those two are both on node ip-10-0-45-12.eu-west-1. `kubectl describe pod` shows `ImagePullBackOff` on the init sidecar for a short time around 1977777550 and a restart policy `Never` which meant they never finished the post-rotation rollout. Logs:

```
Init container "sidecar-init" failed: ErrImagePull: manifest unknown
Events:
  Warning Failed  5m (x3)  kubelet  Failed to pull image ".../sidecar-init:latest": manifest unknown
```

Root cause: rotation happened, Vault revoke published, but two pods failed to restart so they kept old env.

kyle_platform: Proposed mitigation: roll those pods now and add a small orchestrator check in rotation job to ensure 0 pods running old token. For edge fallback, I've pushed a temporary routing fallback that will accept signed JWTs issued by the old key for 2 minutes while we complete rollout. Config snippet:

```
routing.fallback.accept_old_signing_kid = "acmepay-rot-1977"
routing.fallback.grace_seconds = 120
```

This should reduce 401s during the small window. Will revert after verification. :white_check_mark:

sam_reliability: After rolling the two stuck pods they picked up new token. Verified by `env | grep ACME_TOKEN` and requests now 200. Confirmed in eu-west-1 logs no more 401s for those request_ids. :thumbsup:

marta_sre: Post-action notes: we need these follow-ups:
- rotation job should wait for a successful rollout (check pod env diff) before completing
- add a post-rotation deploy hook to `kubectl rollout restart` if any pods are on nodes with taints or imagepull issues
- add alert: vault revoke events + spike in 401s -> paging
- add QA harness to simulate partial rolling failures

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for `acmepay-proxy` initiated at 1977777850, 1% traffic.

alex_support: Thanks all — ACME confirmed back to normal. Will follow up with customer notes and RCA later. :pray:
